families.decision: Do not create null-profile policy. R3 already permits the main git executable; retain it and add flat package-owned git-* helper inheritance. Existing launcher document, network and SSH policy applies after the transition is corrected. Repeated records do not prove R3 was installed or reloaded on the logged host.
Add the exact multiarch GLib desktop helper with inherit execution. Retain existing manager-mediated launch and application confinement; no recursive /usr/lib execute grant.

Retain existing read-only APT/dpkg grants and main Git execution. Add exact GLib helper, flat Git helpers, read-only udev metadata and eight explicitly named read-only process-status peers. Do not add tracing or raw block-device access.
Allow owner-only proc stat/cmdline and non-hidden single-component document filenames directly in HOME. No recursive new HOME access, hidden credential files or executable mapping.

Add inherit-only xdg-open/env/managed launcher/systemd-run bridge, the existing managed Python abstraction and the exact audited managed Python module names. Do not add an unconfined fallback or an exec profile transition after no_new_privs.

Intentionally not authorized. Add explicit denial of Workspace in parent and decoder domains, including standard constructor aliases. This is path-based policy, not a proof against arbitrary aliasing or changes to other local policy.
Permit installed Glycin config reads, transition to a dedicated decoder constructor child, and paired termination signals. Existing parent capabilities remain unchanged.

Use the existing namespace-construction abstraction in a dedicated child and inherit into package decoder executables after no_new_privs. The 138 inherited-descriptor records include incidental browser-state/GPU descriptors and are not copied as a blanket decoder grant. No new Internet network rule or user-documents abstraction. The new child does not use attach_disconnected.
Read-only battery cycle_count, owner proc net/dev and CPU present metadata in the affected helper profiles only. No mutable sysfs or raw-device permissions.
Two profile_replace STATUS notices are not policy denials and require no grant.

caveat: Classification and offline policy review, not a kernel replay or a guarantee that every logged operation is authorized. The full private raw log is not copied into the publishable repository.
